cells.gaps: No share or count with a denominator of primary clinics entering their own reports: facility entry is evidenced only for the four pilot districts to June 2017 (LSO-024) and for reports automated from the eRegister (LSO-017), and how facilities without it enter theirs is not stated. Tiers and clinics have nothing dated since 2017; finance inside the 36 months is not stated (the donor rows are 2015 and 2022); the 2025 advance (LSO-003) is dated to the year only and the same year carries falling reporting rates (LSO-018, LSO-019), so no twelve-month flag is set. LSO-004 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: The ministry's DHIS2 takes facility reports nationally (231 facilities reporting, LSO-018) and facility-level entry is shown in a minority, so the stage 3 row is met. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary clinics entering their own reports on a share or a count with a denominator, and none is published.

cells.gaps: The 197 facilities (LSO-011) are where the eRegister is in place, reported by the HIV programme on ART and HTS reports, with no denominator and no split of hospitals from clinics; the newest fact on general care (LSO-020, 2023) has it on paper at rural health centres, and nothing shows the planned expansion to all primary care patients delivered. The hospital EMR's standing is disputed and old: withdrawn by one account (LSO-032), in inadequate use at six hospitals by another (LSO-033, 2018). No plan naming the system is held; the 2025 advance (LSO-014) is dated to the year only and LSO-016 reports under-use to September 2025, so no twelve-month flag is set. LSO-005 is from the excluded source and sets nothing.
cells.note: An electronic record exists in some facilities, so the cell is above a paper-only claim, which no dated statement supports for every tier. Stage 3 needs most T1 and T2 hospitals or primary clinics in some districts keeping the general-care record, and the evidence shows a hospital system largely withdrawn and a record confined to HIV and TB patients.
